uncited_claims: Before building the planner, the team must run three prioritized experiments to test the riskiest assumptions:
1. Experiment 1: Low-effort inventory input concierge test (tests assumptions A1 and A7).
2. Experiment 2: Weekly plan vs. same-day recommendations test (tests assumption A2).
3. Experiment 3: Value proposition and subscription pre-order test (tests assumptions A3, A5, and A6).
